intl.title: VCU Admissions - Undergraduate international applicants (English proficiency)

sch.title: VCU Admissions - Out-of-state scholarships (incl. international students)

test_policy.notes: All first-year applicants, including international applicants and those seeking scholarships, get test-optional review regardless of GPA. Exceptions: scores are required for the Honors College Guaranteed Admission Programs; the international page also says SAT or GRE scores are required for pre-nursing/nursing applicants and SAT or ACT for mechanical engineering applicants.

requirements.notes: International first-year applicants must use the Common App ($75 state-required fee, nonrefundable, paid by credit card). Essays are required of all 2027 applicants; at least one recommendation is preferred. Official transcripts in the original language with English translation (notarized copies not accepted), plus passport/visa documents. Minimum 20 academic units on the Monroe Park Campus. School of the Arts applicants submit supplemental materials. Honors College needs an additional application (competitive: 3.5 GPA and SAT 1330 or ACT 29).

deadlines.label: First-year scholarship deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Common App plus official transcript received by Nov. 1 for university-level scholarships (Provost, Deans'); international applicants who apply by Nov. 1 are also considered. Honors College Guaranteed Admission Programs are also due Nov. 1.

deadlines.label: First-year regular decision deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Complete applications by Jan. 15 are guaranteed a decision by April 1. Guaranteed University Admission (GPA 3.5+) uses the same date; the School of the Arts is not eligible for it.

deadlines.label: Response deadline for first-year offers made by April 1
deadlines.notes: If accepted after April 1, respond within two weeks.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived with: IB English A1 grade 5+; grades 9-12 at a US/US-accredited high school with a C or better in English (or WIDA 5.0); GCSE/O-level English language; graduation from an American high school abroad or IB/A-level school with a C or better in English; high school in a listed English-speaking country (UK, Ireland, Canada except Quebec, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, etc.); six college English composition semester hours (C or better); or completing VCU's English Language Program. Other accepted proofs: SAT EBRW 500+, ACT English 16+, Gaokao English 125/150, CBSE English 80%, CET-6 500. Test scores are valid two years from the test date. VCU's TOEFL code is 5570.

english.notes: Exams taken on or before Jan. 20, 2026. TOEFL code 5570.
Exams taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026; the page lists '4.0' without naming the 1-6 scale.

cost.notes: VCU 2026-27 table: tuition and fees combined $17,963 (Virginia resident) / $41,127 (non-resident), based on 15 credits per semester; room $9,259 (first-year double in Rhoads Hall) plus dining $6,630. New first-years add a $250 one-time transition fee. Major-specific fees extra

aid.notes: Out-of-state academic scholarships are open to international students: four-year awards of $10,000 (3.00 high school GPA) to $15,000 (4.00) per year, renewable up to three more years, no separate application; GPA tiers $10,000 / $11,000 (3.25) / $12,000 (3.50) / $14,000 (3.75) / $15,000 (4.00). University-level Provost and Deans' scholarships cover in-state costs only. From the Common Data Set (2024-25): 148 undergraduate nonresidents were awarded institutional aid, average $11,243; whether need-based aid exists for nonresidents could not be read from the Common Data Set check boxes.

majors.notes: Competitive applicants should have at least a B average. First-year applicants not accepted to the College are automatically considered for the undeclared major in the College of Humanities and Sciences. Mechanical engineering applicants must submit SAT or ACT scores (international page).
International page: SAT or GRE scores are required for all pre-nursing and nursing applicants. The nursing admission process itself is not described on the international or first-year pages.
Supplemental portfolio/audition materials are required; arts applicants are not eligible for Guaranteed University Admission.

sat.note: VCU's pages do not print an SAT code; select Virginia Commonwealth University in the College Board code search.

act.note: VCU's pages do not print an ACT code; look it up at act.org.

tier_notes.general: Large urban public research university; admits about 84% of applicants (SAT middle 50% 1010-1260), so an SAT ~1100 international applicant is a likely admit.
tier_notes.business: Our estimate: School of Business; no ranking cited.
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Our estimate: large research university with a medical campus; no ranking cited.
tier_notes.pre_med: Our estimate: VCU has an academic medical center and Honors guaranteed-admission health programs; no ranking cited.
tier_notes.arts_design: Our estimate: School of the Arts is a large, well-known public arts school; no ranking cited.
tier_notes.nursing: Our estimate: School of Nursing in an academic medical center; no ranking cited.
